blurb: Guests join small-group or private tours led by local guides to explore Niagara Falls, USA. Tours include visits to Maid of the Mist boat cruise (seasonal), Cave of the Winds, Prospect Point Observation Tower, Goat Island, Terrapin Point, Luna Island, and Whirlpool State Park. Some tours add helicopter rides or cross-border excursions to Canada.
